question: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was an Indian academician, philosopher and statesman who served as the President of India from _________ & the Vice President from ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1962–1967, 1952–1962**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On 5th September, President of India paid floral tributes to Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan on his birth anniversary, celebrated as Teachers’ Day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Radhakrishnan served as President of India from 1962 to 1967.**
 
• **He was Vice President of India from 1952 to 1962.**
 
• **Born on 5th September 1888, his birthday is celebrated as Teachers’ Day.**
 
• **Awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1954, India’s highest civilian honour.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan__

 __
 
• Profession: Philosopher, academician, statesman
 
• Knighthood awarded in 1931
 
• Known for promoting education and philosophy in India
 
 
 
• Teachers’ Day__
 
 
• Celebrated annually on 5th September
 
• Marks Radhakrishnan’s birth anniversary
 
• Honours teachers’ contributions to society
